evidence.what_it_is: theta = start + lambda * (C2 - start): experts at lambda 0.5 of the campaign-2 final state (run_20261122T200945Z_c2_full round 84), router fragments at lambda 0, i.e. the upcycle's zero router and the base final LayerNorm. A zero router ties all 8 experts, so top-2 is the device's tie-break: on CPU (where it was judged) every token goes to experts 6 (stars) and 5 (exoplanets) at gate 0.5. It is a fixed two-adapter path, not a routed mixture of experts. On CUDA the tie-break picks experts 0 and 1 (inferred, E-MOE-C3), an unmeasured model; the producer refuses to serve there.
evidence.metric: mean next-token NLL in nats on tokens 64..127 of never-used rows, paired against the same frozen base (frozen mid-row judge, spec sha256 dce3b43e...)
evidence.guard: every scored domain within +1 % of the base on the selection split, the third split and the frozen 240 chunks
evidence.not_measured: chat or instruction quality, safety behaviour, long-context behaviour, GPU half-precision equivalence; any GPU (the zero-router tie-break differs there)
